description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (94.827) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (78.669) less the matching prior-year period (69.926).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 94.827，加本财年累计 78.669，减去上年同期累计 69.926。

description.en: The model holds disclosed period-end common shares outstanding constant. Additional future dilution may change per-share value.
description.zh: 模型固定采用已披露的期末流通普通股数。未来进一步稀释可能改变每股价值。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Vehicle pricing remains under pressure and energy growth only offsets some weakness.
rationale.zh: 整车定价持续受压，储能增长只能抵消部分弱势。

rationale.en: Deliveries and storage grow, with a gradual recovery in operating leverage.
rationale.zh: 交付量和储能增长，经营杠杆逐步恢复。

rationale.en: A stronger vehicle and energy mix supports higher earnings from deployed products.
rationale.zh: 汽车和能源组合改善，提高已商业化产品的盈利。
